item.title: MODOFO 6 Tier Rak Dapur Kitchen Spice Rack Steel Microwave Oven Rak Barang Dapur Organizer Storage Rack With Wheel
item.description:
Product Specifications
Brand: MODOFO
Product Name: 6-Tier Kitchen Storage Cabinet
Main Material: Carbon Steel
Depth: 42cm
Total Height: 180cm
Installation: Self-assembly required
Assembly Method: Follow the included instruction manual
Size Options
80cm Version
Product Size: 80 × 42 × 180cm
100cm Version
Product Size: 100 × 42 × 180cm
120cm Version
Product Size: 120 × 42 × 180cm
Manual measurement may result in a small size difference.
Package Includes
· 1 × Main cabinet frame set
· 1 × Chopstick holder
· 2 × Hanging racks
· 4 × Hooks
· Foot pads
· Wheels
· Assembly components
· Instruction manual
Product Highlights
1. 6-Tier All-in-One Kitchen Storage
Organise kitchen appliances, cookware, tableware, seasonings, food supplies and daily essentials within one vertical storage unit.
The multi-zone structure combines upper storage, an open appliance area, a spacious worktop, pegboard organisation and a lower cabinet to help reduce clutter around the kitchen.
2. 42cm Deep and Spacious Worktop
The 42cm-deep countertop provides more usable space than a narrow kitchen rack.
It can accommodate selected countertop appliances, cookware, serving items or ingredients and may also be used as a temporary food-preparation or serving area.
Please measure your appliance before purchase to confirm that it fits the available space.
3. Open Storage and Closed Cabinets
Frequently used appliances and kitchen supplies can be placed in the open middle section for easier access.
Items that you prefer to keep protected or out of sight can be stored inside the upper and lower cabinets, helping the kitchen look cleaner and more organised.
4. Space-Saving Flip-Up Upper Door
The upper cabinet features a flip-up door that opens upwards instead of swinging to the left or right.
This design requires less side clearance and makes the cabinet suitable for kitchens, dining areas or utility spaces with limited room.
5. 4-Level Adjustable Lower Shelf
The lower storage level offers four height positions, allowing you to adjust the internal layout according to the height of your pots, kitchen containers, tableware or other supplies.
6. Pegboard Storage with Hanging Accessories
The integrated pegboard makes use of vertical space for organising cooking utensils and small kitchen accessories.
The included hooks, hanging racks and chopstick holder help keep frequently used items visible and within reach.
7. Reserved Cable Routing Area
The pegboard area allows appliance cables to be routed more neatly, reducing tangled wires around the worktop.
Always follow the appliance manufacturer's ventilation and electrical safety instructions during use.
8. Carbon Steel Main Structure
The cabinet is made with a carbon steel main structure for a stable furniture-style appearance suitable for everyday kitchen storage.
Load items evenly and avoid exceeding the recommended capacity stated in the product manual.
9. Wheels or Foot Pads Installation
Install the wheels when easier movement and cleaning access
